Name: AT Cute Rugs
Author: orochifrogu
Description:
A really simple rug mod for you all! I really wanted like beachy, grandma, cute, floral vibes and I hope I brought it <3 There are 7 designs of rugs in 7 colours each, for a total of 49 rugs!!! I have an Alternative Textures version (this one) as well as a Content Patcher one which you can find [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34078]HERE[/url]

[size=3]₊✩‧₊˚౨ৎ˚₊✩‧₊ I just released [url=https://youtu.be/mU9H2whIVm4]THIS youtube video[/url] showcasing all of my 'Cute' furniture so far!!! (cribs, beds, rugs) come check it out if you please!![/size][size=3]! ₊✩‧₊˚౨ৎ˚₊✩‧₊[/size]

THIS MOD REQUIRES ALTERNATIVE TEXTURES! (See my [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34078]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ version if it suits you better)

[size=3]DO YOU LIKE THE VIBE OF THIS COLOUR PALETTE?
[/size] ﻿Im coming out with more furniture to fit in this colour family! I'll have my Bed mod coming first to match each colourway here! <3 

HOW TO INSTALL:
1. ensure you have SMAPI and Alternative Textures
2. Install my file
3. unzip it into your 'Mods' folder
You will now have 49 cute rugs with cute names in your game!!!

2. bed mod to match these rugs!

[/size]PLS let me know in the comments I get so excited to read any comments I really appreciate any and all feedback! If you have any issues I'll do my best to help you resolve it! ^3^

That's it!!! orochifrogu OUT XOXO
